text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, this is the worst... How could I
have made
this mistake?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
At the cafeteria... Manhattan Cafe sat
next to me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Which is fine in itself... but I drank her
coffee by
mistake.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The color and the smell, it was so
evidently
coffee. How could I have made
such a mistake?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, my mouth still tastes bitter...
